lines.en: Three legs alternating, steady gait.
Old patterns carved on my shield face.

lines.zh: 我是被炼出来的，不是生的
lines.en: I was smelted, not born.
My plates clink as I move.
Ceremonial steps: slow and even.
This shield stands taller than a person.
Seven points of armor, all in the shield.
One step, a pause; I patrol.
My legs curve in three bends, just so.
My passing leaves scratches.

lines.zh: 海嗣的东西，也学会了站岗
lines.en: A seaborn thing learned to stand guard.
The shield stays up; so do I.
Standing still, I am a wall.
Waiting for someone to touch me.
An alchemy construct needn't breathe.
The shield face gleams cold.
Three legs planted in the ground.
I hear the tide far off.
Thirty-two points of life, not much.
No orders, so I stand.
Old scars mark this shield.
I turn slowly, scanning.
You stand on my shield's face.
Closer, and I'll read it as an attack.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但看得见你
lines.en: No eyes, yet I see you.
This shield isn't for show.

lines.zh: 你的脚步很轻，可惜我听得到
lines.en: Light steps, but I hear them.
Move first, so I can judge you.
A ceremonial shield doesn't stand to welcome.
There is the tang of the sea on your hem.
Half a step back would be wise.
I've memorized your outline.
A dent knocked into my iron.
Half a step back; the shield holds.
You hit a seam.

lines.zh: 我听见自己裂开的声音
lines.en: I hear myself cracking.
This won't stop my counter.
A fresh mark on my face.
Constructs can be broken too.
One of my three legs trembles.
I've learned your angle.
Once more, and you get it back.
I'm iron; I don't eat.
You hold food, and I have no mouth.
Alchemy constructs need no feeding.
You're wasting that food.
I know bait, and I know traps.
Raise it so I see clearly.
This means nothing to me.
What do you hope to trade for that?
I only block; I don't eat.
Put it away; stop holding it up.
You hit the shield face and went back.
Seven points of armor aren't decoration.
These three legs hold firm.
Iron on bone, an audible click.
Go around; don't force through.
My shield tilts and you slide off.
I stand where I was set.
That bump should numb your hand.
I give half a block; pass.
Bump again and I'll strike back.
Alchemy constructs have no such thing.

lines.zh: 造我的那双手，没给我留这个
lines.en: The hands that made me left no room for that.
No kin, and no partner.
You mistake iron for a living thing.
Shield against shield only clangs.
I keep watch, not company.
An odd question to ask.
I lack the structure for it.
Ask the one who made me.
I can't leave my post.
Something on the ground; I shift over.
Bending is hard on three legs.
I scoop it up with my shield rim.
Iron on iron, a crisp sound.
I pin it so it isn't taken.
This isn't part of my duty.
Picked up and left there.
You needn't pick it up for me.
Something's caught under my shield.
I move slowly; don't rush me.
You struck me, so I answer.
Shield raised toward you.
I was only standing.
Eight points of damage; remember it.
My three legs pick up pace.
A ceremonial shield can crush too.
You broke the rule here.

lines.zh: 炼金造物记得每一次挨打
lines.en: Alchemy remembers every blow.
I won't chase far, but I will chase.

lines.zh: 盾面的旧伤，就是你这样的手留下的
lines.en: Old scars like yours mark my face.
Stand still; stop circling.
This is my return gift.
Iron needs no rage.
Slow, but accurate.
Your hand is still raised.
Then let us begin.
I shuffle toward you, step by step.
The shield's up; you can't reach.
Three legs, one straight line.
No hurry; you can't circle out.
You retreat; I shuffle after.
Iron has long patience.
I'll pen you into a corner.
My shield face stays on you.
Hear that clicking?
Each step shortens the gap.
You're thinking of my flank.
There's iron on the flank too.
I needn't catch my breath.
Your hands hold nothing.
Still running? I'll wait.
This shield remembers your position.
Slow, because heavy.
A tilt of the shield means it's coming down.

lines.zh: 海嗣的东西，也会算角度
lines.en: Even a seaborn thing calculates angles.

lines.zh: 你背后的墙，已经碰着肩了
lines.en: The wall behind you is already at your shoulder.
The shield face comes down.
My shield rim sweeps across.
Three legs push and I ram.
All the iron's weight is in the shield.
Eight points, no exaggeration.
You blocked, but slid half a step.
This one lands at your feet.
I shove the shield forward.
Your weapon got knocked aside.
No technique, only weight.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，你手就抬不起来
lines.en: One more and your arm won't lift.
I'm behind the shield; you're in front.
My strikes come slowly.
But every one is measured.

lines.zh: 你左肋空着，我的盾往那儿去
lines.en: Your left side is open; my shield goes there.
This one goes for your knee.
Iron doesn't tire.
I press it down.
You're at the shield's edge.
Shield back, stance set.
Three legs land and hold.
The alchemy circle flashed.
An old shield stands here.

lines.zh: 我从熔炉的东西里站起来
lines.en: I rise from what the furnace made.
Ceremonial shield in position.
The patterns are still fresh.
No orders; I stand on my own.
The damp here is heavy.

lines.zh: 三十二点生命，够守一阵
lines.en: Thirty-two points of life, enough to hold a while.

lines.zh: 三只脚砸进土里，我立住了
lines.en: Three legs drive into the soil and I hold.
My old scars came with me.

lines.zh: 海嗣的手笔，又是这种造物
lines.en: Seaborn work: another such construct.
The iron glows red.
I fell shield-first.
Water in my joints; they won't turn.
The blast dented my shield face.
Something's stuck in a seam.
Even alchemy fears another craft.

lines.zh: 没有能量补给，我慢下来
lines.en: No energy to draw on; I'm slowing.
Lightning runs the iron; everything goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，盾也撑不住
lines.en: No ground beneath, and the shield can't hold.
